_comment: Ancient Ruins collection (carved temple stone with glyphs, not the plain Stone Statues of #8). Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed ancient-ruins-glyph`, then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_ruins.py, one thin module per look.

readme.title: Ancient Ruins
readme.summary: Pokemon as relics of lost temples: carved stone blocks with ancient glyphs that still glow.
looks: each line wears one look, cut into carved stone blocks: Mesoamerican sandstone with stepped-fret bands and jade (Numel, Flamigo, Darumaka); limestone with hieroglyph bands and lapis and gold paint (Sinistea, Poltchageist, Enamorus); jungle temple stone overgrown with moss and hanging vines (Foongus, Joltik, Wurmple); a sunken ruin with barnacles, coral and seaweed (Dondozo, Palkia, Illumise); wind-eroded sandstone strata with sand at the feet (Rhyhorn, Shieldon, Volbeat); a basalt guardian with glowing dot-glyph circuits (Deoxys, Tinkatink, Morpeko)
cracks and weathering; the glyphs and eyes glow in the dark and slowly pulse
shiny: the glyph light turned round the colour wheel
